about: Conformance vectors for the fresh_at PCActn member. context.fresh_at: {signer, scope, local, max_token_age_ms?, require?, side_carried?}. Generated by packages/pca/src/fresh-at-vectors.test.ts.

vectors.name: member-equal-state
vectors.description: Verifier state equals the token: fresh_at passes.

vectors.name: member-newer-state
vectors.description: Verifier is ahead of the token on every counter.

vectors.name: member-stale-revocation_epoch
vectors.description: Verifier is behind the token on revocation_epoch: escalate (stale_state), never allow.

expect.reason: fresh_at: escalate: stale_state (verifier state is behind the token on revocation_epoch)

vectors.name: member-stale-ledger_tree_size
vectors.description: Verifier is behind the token on ledger_tree_size: escalate (stale_state), never allow.

expect.reason: fresh_at: escalate: stale_state (verifier state is behind the token on ledger_tree_size)

vectors.name: member-stale-budget_version
vectors.description: Verifier is behind the token on budget_version: escalate (stale_state), never allow.

expect.reason: fresh_at: escalate: stale_state (verifier state is behind the token on budget_version)

vectors.name: member-stale-policy-revision
vectors.description: Verifier runs an older policy revision than the token.

expect.reason: fresh_at: escalate: stale_state (verifier state is behind the token on policy_revision)

vectors.name: member-stale-two-fields
vectors.description: Two counters behind: both are named, in field order.

expect.reason: fresh_at: escalate: stale_state (verifier state is behind the token on revocation_epoch, budget_version)

vectors.name: member-policy-fork
vectors.description: Same policy revision, different digest: a fork is a hard denial.

expect.reason: fresh_at: policy_fork

vectors.name: member-wrong-scope
vectors.description: The token is for another scope.

expect.reason: fresh_at: wrong_scope

vectors.name: member-wrong-signer
vectors.description: The verifier pins a different token signer.

expect.reason: fresh_at: bad_token

vectors.name: member-too-old
vectors.description: maxTokenAgeMs is exceeded (token age 1000 ms, limit 999).

expect.reason: fresh_at: token_too_old

vectors.name: member-age-boundary
vectors.description: Token age equals the limit: ok.

vectors.name: member-from-the-future
vectors.description: The token is issued more than 60 s after the verifier clock.

expect.reason: fresh_at: token_from_the_future

vectors.name: member-future-skew-boundary
vectors.description: Issued exactly 60 s ahead: ok.

vectors.name: member-forged-token-signature
vectors.description: The token signature does not verify (the PCActn itself is correctly signed over it).

expect.reason: fresh_at: bad_token

vectors.name: member-swapped-after-signing
vectors.description: The member was replaced after the leaf signed: leaf_signature fails.

expect.reason: leaf_signature: signature does not verify under the leaf holder key / suite

vectors.name: member-without-policy
vectors.description: The PCActn carries fresh_at but the verifier has no fresh_at policy: refused (fail closed).

expect.reason: fresh_at: the PCActn carries fresh_at but this verifier has no fresh_at policy (fail closed)

vectors.name: no-member-no-policy
vectors.description: No member and no policy: the check is not reported (byte-identical to before).

vectors.name: no-member-policy-not-required
vectors.description: A policy that does not require a token and no token: not reported.

vectors.name: no-member-required
vectors.description: The policy requires a token and none is presented: escalate (refresh and retry).

expect.reason: fresh_at: escalate: a consistency token is required (refresh and retry with the token of your latest write)

vectors.name: side-carried-ok
vectors.description: No member, a side-carried token (the pre-member form, readable for one release) at the verifier state: ok.

vectors.name: side-carried-stale
vectors.description: The side-carried token is ahead of the verifier: escalate.

expect.reason: fresh_at: escalate: stale_state (verifier state is behind the token on revocation_epoch)

vectors.name: member-wins-over-side-carried
vectors.description: Both present: the signed member is what counts, the header beside it is ignored.

vectors.name: side-carried-garbage
vectors.description: A side-carried value that is not a token is a bad token (deny), never a missing one.

expect.reason: fresh_at: bad_token

vectors.name: wire-unknown-member-key
vectors.description: Malformed member ('fresh_at' has an unknown field 'extra'): the wire check fails and nothing else is evaluated.

expect.reason: wire: 'fresh_at' has an unknown field 'extra'

vectors.name: wire-negative-counter
vectors.description: Malformed member ('fresh_at.revocation_epoch' must be a non-negative safe integer): the wire check fails and nothing else is evaluated.

expect.reason: wire: 'fresh_at.revocation_epoch' must be a non-negative safe integer

vectors.name: wire-short-signature
vectors.description: Malformed member ('fresh_at.sig' is not canonical base64url (64 bytes)): the wire check fails and nothing else is evaluated.

expect.reason: wire: 'fresh_at.sig' is not canonical base64url (64 bytes)

vectors.name: wire-not-an-object
vectors.description: Malformed member ('fresh_at' must be an object): the wire check fails and nothing else is evaluated.

expect.reason: wire: 'fresh_at' must be an object
